description: This file defines configuration structures, constants, and types for the Kubernetes kubelet, including networking, resource management, authentication, credential providers, and node settings.

classes.name: KubeletConfiguration
classes.description: Main configuration struct for the kubelet, encompassing networking, resource management, security, and operational parameters.

classes.name: KubeletAuthorization
classes.description: Holds authorization mode and webhook settings for kubelet request authorization.

classes.name: KubeletWebhookAuthorization
classes.description: Contains cache TTL settings for webhook authorization responses.

classes.name: KubeletAuthentication
classes.description: Holds authentication settings including x509, webhook, and anonymous authentication options.

classes.name: KubeletX509Authentication
classes.description: Configuration for x509 client certificate authentication, including client CA file path.

classes.name: KubeletWebhookAuthentication
classes.description: Webhook authentication settings with enable flag and cache TTL.

classes.name: KubeletAnonymousAuthentication
classes.description: Enables or disables anonymous requests to the kubelet server.

classes.name: SerializedNodeConfigSource
classes.description: Internal type for serializing NodeConfigSource, used for checkpointed dynamic configs.

classes.name: CredentialProviderConfig
classes.description: Configuration for credential provider plugins used by kubelet for image pulls.

classes.name: CredentialProvider
classes.description: Represents an exec plugin invoked for matching images to provide credentials.

classes.name: ServiceAccountTokenAttributes
classes.description: Config for service account tokens passed to credential plugins, including audience and cache type.

classes.name: ExecEnvVar
classes.description: Environment variable for exec credential plugins.

classes.name: MemoryReservation
classes.description: Memory reservation settings per NUMA node.

classes.name: ShutdownGracePeriodByPodPriority
classes.description: Shutdown grace period configuration based on pod priority.

classes.name: MemorySwapConfiguration
classes.description: Swap memory configuration for container workloads.

classes.name: CrashLoopBackOffConfig
classes.description: Configuration for container restart behavior in case of crash loops.

classes.name: ImagePullCredentialsVerificationPolicy
classes.description: Enum for image pull credential verification policies.

classes.name: ImagePullIntent
classes.description: Record of kubelet attempting to pull an image.

classes.name: ImagePulledRecord
classes.description: Record of an image pulled by kubelet, including credential mapping.

classes.name: ImagePullCredentials
classes.description: Credentials used to pull images, including secrets and service accounts.

classes.name: ImagePullSecret
classes.description: Coordinates and credential hash for a Kubernetes secret used in image pulling.

classes.name: ImagePullServiceAccount
classes.description: Coordinates for a Kubernetes service account used in image pulling.

classes.name: UserNamespaces
classes.description: Configuration for user namespace support, including UID/GID mapping per pod.
